resources.string: Can\'t check the apps right now
There are no hidden apps to add.
It will appear on the home screen, below the other apps.

At the monthly check on %1$s, you noted that %2$s didn\'t update. The usual fixes are: try again at the next monthly check, or ask %3$s. %2$s still opens. LMNOPhone can\'t tell whether a newer version exists.
An app appeared that you haven\'t added
%1$s, made by %2$s, was installed on %3$s. It wasn\'t added in a Play Store session, so it\'s hidden and can\'t be opened. Phones sometimes install apps on their own.
An app appeared that LMNOPhone couldn\'t hide
It still can\'t be opened. It might run in the background. Ask %1$s to remove it.
LMNOPhone can\'t send texts from this phone right now, so you may not hear about %1$s\'s requests or the monthly check. Requests are still saved here. Calls and texts that %1$s sends still work.

%1$s needs to be here with a computer on the same Wi-Fi. %1$s will tell you the address to type. LMNOPhone checks that the update really comes from the LMNOPhone team before installing it. If an update goes badly wrong, there\'s no undo. The fix is the last-resort reset in the setup guide.
It looks like 192.168.1.20:8080. %1$s\'s computer shows it.
Keep the phone near the Wi-Fi. This can take up to 2 minutes.
Couldn\'t get the update from that address. Check it with %1$s. Nothing has changed.
That file is too big to be an LMNOPhone update. Nothing has changed.
That file isn\'t a genuine LMNOPhone update, so it wasn\'t installed. Nothing has changed. Tell %1$s.
This phone already has that version or a newer one. Nothing has changed.
This update is from the LMNOPhone team. The phone will be busy for a minute. Calls and Emergency still work.
First there\'s a %1$d-minute wait. Then you tap Start, and %2$s is open for %3$d minutes. This uses 1 of your %4$d openings left today. Restarting the phone stops the wait, and nothing is used up.
You can add %1$s when the countdown ends.
You can install the update when the countdown ends.
Then you\'ll have 5 minutes to tap Start. If you don\'t, it closes again and doesn\'t count. Your phone works as usual meanwhile. Restarting the phone stops the countdown.
Tap Start within %1$d minutes. This uses 1 of your %2$d openings left today.
Tap Start within 1 minute. This uses 1 of your %1$d openings left today.
You\'ve used your %1$d openings. The next one is available after about %2$s, if the phone stays on. Restarting the phone doesn\'t change this.
Openings are set to 0 a day. You can change that in Waits and limits; making it higher takes 24 hours.
%1$s is counting down. Finish or stop that first.
%1$s is open until %2$s. Finish or stop that first.
This didn\'t open. Nothing was used up. Try again.
You can add each app you installed until %1$s.
The time ran out, so %1$s stays hidden. You can add it with another opening.
It was for one app. Use another opening to add %1$s.
It wasn\'t ready before %1$s. Nothing changed. Try again with another opening.
Longer waits and fewer openings start straight away. Shorter waits and more openings take 24 hours of the phone being on, like other changes that open things up.
Saved. This applies now, including to a wait that\'s already running.
Changes made on this phone in the last 90 days. It doesn\'t include messages, websites or what happens inside apps.
On the phone, without a PIN
This makes %1$s\'s phone an ordinary Android phone again. Every app will open, including web browsers and the Play Store, and the home screen will look different.
This makes your phone an ordinary Android phone again. Every app will open, including web browsers and the Play Store, and the home screen will look different.
Photos, messages and contacts are kept. Nothing is erased.
It happens after at least 24 hours of the phone being on. Until then, anyone holding the phone can cancel, and %1$s will get a text now.
It happens after at least 24 hours of the phone being on. Until then, you can cancel it. Nothing can make it shorter.
To use LMNOPhone again later, %1$s has to set it up again with a computer.
LMNOPhone only turns off this way, with a PIN. A flat battery doesn\'t turn it off: when the phone starts again, LMNOPhone is back.
LMNOPhone will be turned off on %1$s\'s phone.
LMNOPhone will be turned off on your phone.
Once it\'s off, only %1$s can turn it back on, using a computer. LMNOPhone turns off after at least 24 hours of the phone being on. Time while the phone is off doesn\'t count.
Step %1$d of %2$d. Keep the phone on. Calls and Emergency still work.
Still turning off. Carrying on from where it stopped.
This is now an ordinary phone. Android will ask which home screen to use; pick the one that isn\'t LMNOPhone.
Nothing has been erased, and calls and Emergency still work. LMNOPhone stopped at: %1$s. Call %2$s and show this screen.
The update check isn\'t finished. You can start it again from the front page.
Google Play services hasn\'t updated in 30 days. This is often fine. If it\'s still the same next month, mention it to %1$s.
%1$s doesn\'t ask to use anything here.
Couldn\'t set what this app can use.
